landmarks.name: The Bay Light and the Mole
landmarks.what: a stone breakwater running 100 tiles out into the bay from the north pier, a two-storey lighthouse at its head

landmarks.name: The Clock Tower
landmarks.what: a two-storey clock and bell tower on Clock Square, where Abbey Row meets Gate Street

landmarks.name: The Wall-Builders
landmarks.what: a statue group of the first Greatly masons with trowel and plumb line, on Greatly Square below the compound gate: "They raised the wall; the wall raised the city"

landmarks.name: Pillory Square
landmarks.what: the square before the Old Keep's gate: the gallows, the pillory and the stocks where the Watch shows its catch

landmarks.name: The Mercy
landmarks.what: an old Grayrock carrack hauled up on the quay at the Sump's edge, her hull the Knucklebones tavern

landmarks.name: The Cisterns and the Runnel
landmarks.what: three stone rain tanks on Cistern Court that feed the bathhouse, and the Runnel, an open gutter channel running from them down the Gut to the quay

landmarks.name: The Hundred Steps
landmarks.what: a stair-street two wide climbing from the quay up through the north Sump and the Northgate edge to Abbey Row

landmarks.name: The Sunken Street
landmarks.what: the city's old street level under the Sump's edge, a vaulted cobbled lane 54 tiles long, reached by a stair-house in the Sump and another in the Commons

landmarks.name: The Tallow Arcade
landmarks.what: a covered arcade, a through-building of pillars and benches between two streets of the Commons on the Sump's edge, out of the rain
